_comment: Paste each tool object into the Vapi dashboard, or send via Vapi API. Tool names MUST match the dispatcher in src/routes/tools.ts exactly.

server.secret: set this to VAPI_WEBHOOK_SECRET if you enabled it; sent as x-vapi-secret header

function.name: check_availability
function.description: Check if a specific date and time is available for a reservation. Call this before attempting to book.

date.description: Reservation date in YYYY-MM-DD format (restaurant local timezone).

time.description: Reservation time in 24-hour HH:MM format (restaurant local timezone).

function.name: create_reservation
function.description: Book a reservation. Only call after check_availability confirms the slot is free.

phone.description: Optional phone number for the reservation.

email.description: Optional email address. If provided, the guest will receive a Google Calendar invite so the reservation appears on their personal calendar.

function.name: lookup_reservation
function.description: Find an existing reservation by confirmation code or phone number. Provide at least one.

function.name: cancel_reservation
function.description: Cancel an existing reservation by confirmation code.

function.name: get_restaurant_info
function.description: Return basic restaurant info: name, hours, max party size, location.
